The IMF Conditionality Dataset records the policy conditions attached to IMF lending programs in {{< dataset-value period >}}: {{< dataset-value counts.conditions >}} conditions in {{< dataset-value counts.countries >}} countries. They are taken from the Letters of Intent and Memoranda of Economic and Financial Policies that borrowing governments draft with IMF staff, found in IMF Executive Board documents and Country Reports. Each condition is classified by type, from prior actions to structural benchmarks, and into one of {{< dataset-value counts.policy_areas >}} policy areas. The main dataset gives yearly indicators for {{< dataset-value counts.panel >}} countries and territories; the raw dataset lists each condition. The codebook explains how the data were collected, coded, and combined.

## Publications using the data

<!-- Confirmed by Thomas, 20 October 2026. Sources: the two codebooks'
     citations and the replication records in the IMF Monitor Dataverse
     collection; journal details checked against Crossref the same day. -->

Newest first. The current codebook asks users to cite Kentikelenis and Stubbs (2023); the first, in 2017, asked for Kentikelenis, Stubbs, and King (2016).

- Kentikelenis, A. & Stubbs, T. (2023). *A Thousand Cuts: Social Protection in the Age of Austerity*. Oxford University Press. <https://doi.org/10.1093/oso/9780190637736.001.0001>
- Reinsberg, B., Stubbs, T., & Bujnoch, L. (2023). Structural adjustment, alienation, and mass protest. *Social Science Research*, 109, 102777. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ssresearch.2022.102777>
- Kentikelenis, A. & Stubbs, T. (2022). Austerity redux: The post-pandemic wave of budget cuts and the future of global public health. *Global Policy*, 13(1), 5–17. <https://doi.org/10.1111/1758-5899.13028>
- Reinsberg, B., Stubbs, T., & Kentikelenis, A. (2022). Compliance, defiance, and the dependency trap: International Monetary Fund program interruptions and their impact on capital markets. *Regulation & Governance*, 16(4), 1022–1041. <https://doi.org/10.1111/rego.12422>
- Reinsberg, B., Stubbs, T., & Kentikelenis, A. (2022). Unimplementable by design? Understanding (non-)compliance with International Monetary Fund policy conditionality. *Governance*, 35(3), 689–715. <https://doi.org/10.1111/gove.12605>
- Reinsberg, B., Kentikelenis, A., & Stubbs, T. (2021). Creating crony capitalism: Neoliberal globalization and the fueling of corruption. *Socio-Economic Review*, 19(2), 607–634. <https://doi.org/10.1093/ser/mwz039>
- Reinsberg, B., Stubbs, T., & Kentikelenis, A. (2020). Taxing the people, not trade: The International Monetary Fund and the structure of taxation in developing countries. *Studies in Comparative International Development*, 55(3), 278–304. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s12116-020-09307-4>
- Reinsberg, B., Stubbs, T., Kentikelenis, A., & King, L. (2020). Bad governance: How privatization increases corruption in the developing world. *Regulation & Governance*, 14(4), 698–717. <https://doi.org/10.1111/rego.12265>
- Stubbs, T., Reinsberg, B., Kentikelenis, A., & King, L. (2020). How to evaluate the effects of IMF conditionality: An extension of quantitative approaches and an empirical application to public education spending. *Review of International Organizations*, 15(1), 29–73. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s11558-018-9332-5>
- Reinsberg, B., Kentikelenis, A., Stubbs, T., & King, L. (2019). The world system and the hollowing out of state capacity: How structural adjustment programs affect bureaucratic quality in developing countries. *American Journal of Sociology*, 124(4), 1222–1257. <https://doi.org/10.1086/701703>
- Reinsberg, B., Stubbs, T., Kentikelenis, A., & King, L. (2019). The political economy of labor market deregulation during IMF interventions. *International Interactions*, 45(3), 532–559. <https://doi.org/10.1080/03050629.2019.1582531>
- Stubbs, T., Kentikelenis, A., Stuckler, D., McKee, M., & King, L. (2017). The impact of IMF conditionality on government health expenditure: A cross-national analysis of 16 West African nations. *Social Science & Medicine*, 174, 220–227. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.socscimed.2016.12.016>
- Kentikelenis, A., Stubbs, T., & King, L. (2016). IMF conditionality and development policy space, 1985–2014. *Review of International Political Economy*, 23(4), 543–582. <https://doi.org/10.1080/09692290.2016.1174953>
- Stubbs, T., Kentikelenis, A., & King, L. (2016). Catalyzing aid? The IMF and donor behavior in aid allocation. *World Development*, 78, 511–528. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.worlddev.2015.10.010>
